title: sida rhombifolia subsp. insularis
intro: Sida rhombifolia subsp. insularis, commonly known as the island sida, is a plant species that belongs to the Malvaceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The health benefits of this plant include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve immune function, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in Sida rhombifolia subsp. insularis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects.
